concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-prepare-reports-generate-download-reports]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms report-generation/download guide for role-gated scheduled or one-time creation, report-created download URL and authenticated file retrieval; disabling automatic generation deletes its schedule, and a notification is not report-content proof.
warnings: The report schedule depends on report type and balance-platform configuration; this source gives no universal delivery time or reconciliation algorithm.
A report-created webhook provides a download URL, not the downloaded file or evidence of settlement/bank receipt.
